verdict.rationale: Controlling trace and log sampling and retention tiers is a fair question for an observability platform like Datadog, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only page titles for APM and Log Management, with no content documenting trace sampling rules, log indexing or exclusion filters, or retention tiers. The community items about pricing and cost do not describe any volume-control capability, so they are irrelevant to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately
